vulnerabilityExceptions.name: golang.org/x/net
vulnerabilityExceptions.reason: New advisories surfaced by the Go vulnerability database on 2026-08-01 after the pinned dependency set was cut. The affected paths (SVCB/HTTPS RR parsing) are not exercised by shipped features. Upgrade golang.org/x/net to v0.56.0 or newer in the next dependency pass.

vulnerabilityExceptions.name: go.opentelemetry.io/otel
vulnerabilityExceptions.reason: New advisories surfaced by the Go vulnerability database on 2026-08-01 after the pinned dependency set was cut. Baggage parsing runs on trusted loopback traffic only. Upgrade go.opentelemetry.io/otel to v1.42.0 or newer in the next dependency pass.

vulnerabilityExceptions.name: google.golang.org/grpc
vulnerabilityExceptions.reason: New advisories surfaced by the Go vulnerability database on 2026-08-01 after the pinned dependency set was cut. gRPC xDS/HTTP2 transport paths are not part of the shipped control surface. Upgrade google.golang.org/grpc to v1.82.1 or newer in the next dependency pass.

vulnerabilityExceptions.name: golang.org/x/text
vulnerabilityExceptions.reason: New advisories surfaced by the Go vulnerability database on 2026-08-01 after the pinned dependency set was cut. The infinite-loop path requires hostile untrusted text input not present in the loopback server. Upgrade golang.org/x/text to v0.39.0 or newer in the next dependency pass.
